/** * Import page — Connect step of the Grepo workflow. * * Supports: * - ZIP upload (preserves existing safe extraction) * - Public GitHub URL import (read-only, commit-pinned) * * Corrections applied from PRD §26: * - No fictional testimonials * - No unsupported "never store your code" privacy guarantees * - Source policy notice is accurate to actual behavior * - No unimplemented controls presented as working */ import { useRef, useState } from 'react' import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom' import { importGitHub, importZip } from '../services/v1/api' import type { ImportAccepted } from '../types/v1' type TabId = 'github' | 'zip' type ImportState = | { status: 'idle' } | { status: 'loading'; stage: string } | { status: 'done'; result: ImportAccepted } | { status: 'error'; message: string } export default function ImportPage() { const navigate = useNavigate() const [tab, setTab] = useState('github') const [githubUrl, setGithubUrl] = useState('') const [githubRef, setGithubRef] = useState('') const [importState, setImportState] = useState({ status: 'idle' }) const fileRef = useRef(null) async function handleGitHubSubmit(e: React.FormEvent) { e.preventDefault() if (!githubUrl.trim()) return setImportState({ status: 'loading', stage: 'Connecting to GitHub…' }) try { const result = await importGitHub({ url: githubUrl.trim(), ref: githubRef.trim() || 'HEAD', }) setImportState({ status: 'done', result }) navigate(`/p/${result.project_id}`) } catch (err) { setImportState({ status: 'error', message: err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Import failed.', }) } } async function handleZipSubmit(e: React.FormEvent) { e.preventDefault() const file = fileRef.current?.files?.[0] if (!file) return setImportState({ status: 'loading', stage: 'Uploading and extracting…' }) try { const result = await importZip(file) setImportState({ status: 'done', result }) navigate(`/p/${result.project_id}`) } catch (err) { setImportState({ status: 'error', message: err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Upload failed.', }) } } const isLoading = importState.status === 'loading' return (
